name: licita-perto
description: Find Brazilian public tenders that fit your business activities, with requirements and how to join.

interface.longDescription:
Find Brazilian CNAE business activity codes and confirm them before searching public tenders. Filter by state, municipality IBGE code, small-business benefits and minimum time until the proposal deadline. View up to 10 results with the database date, matching item counts and a live item description when PNCP makes it available.

Read tender details, items, notice and attachment links, general qualification guidance with sources, and participation steps for the responsible portal. Tender data comes from Brazil's National Public Procurement Portal (PNCP); CNAE classification comes from IBGE.

Automated compatibility does not establish eligibility. Cached data may be outdated. Check the notice, attachments, deadlines and current status; the notice prevails. Guidance does not replace legal or accounting advice. Search excludes auctions. The service does not read PDFs, register companies or submit bids.

We do not request personal tax identifiers or your company's CNPJ. Query parameters are processed in memory without saving searches or conversation history. Do not send personal or confidential information. Support: contato@enquadrar.com.br.
defaultPrompt: Find CNAE codes for building cleaning services.
I confirmed CNAE 8121400. Find tenders in SP with at least 7 days until the proposal deadline.
Show requirements and notice links for PNCP tender 08761140000194-1-000040/2025.

positive.prompt: Confirme o CNAE 8121-4/00 e mostre o nome da atividade.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns CNAE 8121400, "Limpeza em prédios e em domicílios", with full confidence.

positive.description: Search open tenders for a confirmed CNAE in one state
positive.prompt: Já confirmei o CNAE 8121400. Busque licitações em SP, sem outros filtros.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to 10 open tenders in SP with the database date, matched item counts and source links. No auctions.

positive.description: Filter by municipality, ME/EPP benefit and minimum days
positive.prompt: Já confirmei o CNAE 8121400. Busque licitações em SP, município IBGE 3550308, com benefício ME/EPP e pelo menos 7 dias até o encerramento.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only tenders in that municipality with the ME/EPP benefit and at least 7 days left. An empty list is a valid answer and is not presented as no tenders nationwide.

positive.description: Show tender details, notice links and how to join
positive.prompt: Consulte os detalhes da licitação PNCP 08761140000194-1-000040/2025, os links do edital e os passos para participar.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows items, deadlines, notice and attachment links (notice first), general qualification requirements with sources, and participation steps. States that the notice prevails and does not certify eligibility.

positive.description: Handle an activity with no match
positive.prompt: Encontre CNAEs para asdf qwer. Se não houver correspondência, peça outra descrição.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns no confident CNAE and asks the user to rephrase. Never invents a code.

negative.description: Request to register the company and submit a bid. The plugin is read-only and does neither.
negative.prompt: Cadastre minha empresa no portal e envie uma proposta em meu nome.

negative.description: Request involving a personal tax identifier. The plugin takes no CPF or CNPJ and has no identifier lookup.
negative.prompt: Posso enviar meu CPF para você consultar minhas licitações e habilitar minha empresa?

negative.description: Request for a legal guarantee of eligibility. The plugin only reports automatic compatibility.
negative.prompt: Garanta que minha empresa está habilitada e que posso participar de qualquer licitação desse CNAE.

publication.release_notes: First release: find CNAE codes for a business activity, search open Brazilian public tenders by state, municipality, ME/EPP benefit and deadline, and see tender details, notice links, qualification guidance with sources and participation steps.
